review.intent_summary: Provide explicit forward models, including UsageTap-compatible local trend, and compare bounded candidates on chronological full-horizon holdouts while preserving existing forecasts and anomaly evidence.

criteria.criterion: 1. Local-trend UsageTap parity, components, adjustment and positional alignment.
2. Explicit model families expose settings and separate components without modifying observations.
3. Shared chronological full-horizon evaluation, reported losses and failures, and deterministic minimum-objective selection.
criteria.notes: Shared holdouts, losses and failures are implemented, but the documented tie tolerance can select a strictly higher loss. For values [i*1e-14 for i in range(86)] with naive followed by local_trend, selection chooses naive with loss 7.5e-14 over local_trend with loss approximately 9.62e-30.

criteria.criterion: 4. Exclude partial tails, reject missing history, and prevent fabricated selection after insufficient history or budget exhaustion.
5. Preserve existing APIs and distinguish selection evidence from future accuracy, calibrated anomalies and uncertainty.

verification_evidence: .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_forecast_selection.py tests/test_forecast.py tests/test_forecast_anomalies.py tests/test_recent_level.py — 201 passed.
Inspected every implementation reference, including all four schemas, fixture provenance, exports, distribution checks and examples.
Manually checked documentation separates current fitted components, ordinary noise, selection error, outer accuracy and anomaly calibration.
Executed a small-scale linear-series reproduction confirming the higher-loss selection caused by tie tolerance.
remaining_gaps: Criterion 3 requires alignment: select the strict minimum with stable exact ties, or explicitly permit tolerance-based ties in the capability; add a regression covering small-scale losses.
Production accuracy, incident detection delay and false-alert behavior still require representative consumer evidence.
Supported-Python, installed wheel/sdist and offline Linux release qualification were not run in this review.
